The Procurement Platform Built for Enterprises and Suppliers Across Malaysia

Borong is a neutral B2B eProcurement platform that connects enterprises, government agencies, and SMEs with vetted wholesale suppliers. Operating on a single, compliant platform, it provides the digital infrastructure needed to automate purchasing workflows, expand supplier networks, and access flexible trade financing.
A trusted B2B procurement platform connecting businesses with verified suppliers, smarter workflows, and flexible financing solutions.
SKUs spanning products & services across every category
Businesses served across enterprises, GLCs, SMEs & public sectors

Borong is Malaysia's neutral digital backbone for enterprises, GLCs, and high-growth firms. It adapts to your sector's regulatory needs, unifying fragmented branches and multi-entity operations under one high-governance platform.
From industry rankings to global accolades, Borong continues to earn recognition for driving innovation, accelerating growth, and reshaping how businesses procure.
One Platform. One Region. One Procurement Network.

Borong covers every stage of the procurement lifecycle, from requisition management and supplier discovery to embedded trade financing and spend intelligence. Each product works independently or as a unified stack.

Digitize your internal purchasing workflows. Borong Procure enforces supplier contracts, automates purchase order creation and builds multi-level approval matrices aligned to your corporate structure. Move procurement off email chains and spreadsheets onto a governance-first system.
Procurement Solutions by Industry | Borong B2B Platform
Procurement Solutions Built for the Complexity of Your Industry

Generic procurement software makes organizations adapt to the tool. Borong works the other way: a modular infrastructure configured to how procurement actually runs in your sector, down to the approval hierarchies, supplier categories, reporting requirements and compliance standards that matter to you.

Energy procurement spans high-value contracts, complex supplier qualification and multiple asset classes from operational consumables to technical MRO. Borong supports it with structured workflows, ERP integration for SAP and Oracle environments, and spend intelligence covering indirect and tail spend across facility operations.

Manufacturers managing indirect spend and MRO across production sites have to keep operations running without overspending on unplanned purchases. Borong consolidates fragmented tail spend, enforces approved supplier catalogs on the factory floor, and feeds purchasing data into ERP systems for accurate cost tracking.

Healthcare procurement needs high compliance standards, vendor verification and full traceability of consumable sourcing. Borong provides the catalog management, audit trails and supplier governance to source operational supplies while holding the documentation standards the regulatory environment requires.

FMCG and retail organizations moving fast inventory need procurement that keeps pace. Borong supports direct-from-brand wholesale sourcing, multi-vendor order consolidation and embedded financing, so buyers manage cash flow across seasonal cycles without slowing supply chain operations.

Whatever the industry, the products work together. Borong Procure handles internal workflow and compliance. Borong Marketplace connects your teams to vetted wholesale suppliers. Borong Credit provides embedded financing when capital is the constraint. MIDAS delivers the spend intelligence behind better sourcing decisions.
All products integrate with your existing ERP and financial systems through standard cXML and OCI protocols, so Borong fits into your technology environment rather than replacing it.

The Indirect Spend Challenge in Manufacturing

Borong gives factory and facility teams a vetted wholesale supplier network for MRO and operational consumables, through an interface straightforward enough to use without training. Site teams order what they need from approved suppliers at pre-negotiated prices, consolidated into one invoice per purchasing cycle.
Approved Vendor Catalogs for Factory Teams

Borong Procure deploys restricted catalogs tailored to each production site or team, so factory floor teams see only what is relevant to their function, from approved suppliers at contract rates. Buying from unverified vendors or above contract becomes impossible, and the process stays fast enough that nobody reverts to informal purchasing to dodge a delay.

Manufacturing generates a large volume of low-value, ad-hoc purchases below the threshold of formal contracts: individually small, collectively significant. Tail-spend management routes them through the central platform, normalizes the data, and brings them under the same governance as strategic purchasing, without putting site teams through a complex procedure for a routine buy.

Borong integrates with manufacturing ERP systems through standard cXML and OCI protocols, flowing procurement data into your ERP automatically so cost center records stay accurate, production budgets current and financial reporting complete. Supported systems include SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics 365 and others commonly deployed in manufacturing environments.

Because Borong does not sell products itself, it has no incentive to distort those benchmarks.

Borong vs Reseller Marketplaces | Side-by-Side Comparison

Unlike a traditional distributor, a reseller marketplace looks like Borong on the surface: many suppliers, one storefront. The difference is structural. A reseller marketplace buys inventory and resells it as the vendor of record. Borong connects buyers directly to suppliers and never becomes the vendor of record itself.
